summary_markdown:
A potential data inconsistency was noted in the Mall Analytics dashboard. Specifically, unique counts (uniques) on default or weekly charts match the traffic data, but the totals section shows a different figure.

Later, discussions addressed dwell-time calculation. It was confirmed that the current dwell-time calculation method has not changed from previous methods, although it is noted that 'screen' and 'cluster' metrics are distinct.
decisions: The team agreed to finalize the release of the analytics dashboards after a final review across all companies and malls.
action_items: Someone needs to prepare an explanation for clients regarding the observed data discrepancy in Mall Analytics.
